housing.summary: Rental market centred on portals and local agencies; typical urban rents in EUR. Long-term leases (contratto di locazione) commonly 4+4 years; deposit usually 1-3 months.
housing.notes: Register the lease with the Agenzia delle Entrate (registrazione del contratto). Codice fiscale required to sign a lease.

banking.summary: Retail banks with branches in Genoa. Codice fiscale and proof of address/residence typically required to open a resident account.
banking.notes: Non-residents can open a conto non residenti with more limited features; full accounts generally require residence.

schools.summary: State schools managed under the Italian national system; international/bilingual options are limited relative to Milan/Rome.

providers.name: Deutsche Schule Genua (Scuola Germanica di Genova)

public_enrolment.authority: Comune di Genova / Ufficio Scolastico Regionale Liguria

schools.notes: Enrolment (iscrizione) for state schools is handled nationally via the MIUR/Ministero dell'Istruzione portal; residence in catchment affects placement.

legal_admin.summary: Residence registration and municipal admin handled by the Comune di Genova; immigration formalities via Questura/Prefettura.
key_steps: register residence (residenza anagrafica) at the Comune
non-EU: apply for/collect permesso di soggiorno
EU citizens staying >3 months: iscrizione anagrafica
legal_admin.notes: EEA-not-EU and non-EU distinctions apply; permesso di soggiorno required for non-EU nationals.

tax_finance.summary: Personal taxation administered nationally by the Agenzia delle Entrate; codice fiscale is the universal tax identifier.
key_items: codice fiscale required for nearly all admin and financial actions
IRPEF national income tax plus regional and municipal surcharges
impatriati / inbound worker tax relief regime may apply to qualifying movers
tax_finance.notes: Regional (Liguria) and municipal (Comune di Genova) surcharges apply on top of national IRPEF.

transport.summary: Urban public transport operated by AMT Genova: buses, metro, funiculars, lifts and the Genova-Casella narrow-gauge railway; regional/national rail via Trenitalia.
transport.notes: Genoa's transit includes a single metro line, funiculars and public lifts serving the hilly terrain. Airport: Genoa Cristoforo Colombo (GOA).

healthcare.summary: Public healthcare via the Servizio Sanitario Nazionale (SSN), locally administered by ASL 3 Genovese; register with the SSN and choose a medico di base after obtaining residence and codice fiscale.
healthcare.notes: SSN registration (tessera sanitaria) requires residence and codice fiscale; EU citizens may use EHIC/TEAM for temporary cover before enrolment.
